name: build_hooks_bitbucket
description: Trigger bitbucket pipelines builds that deploy a frontend environment.
ecosystem_note: Submodule of build_hooks. Adds one FrontendEnvironment plugin ('bitbucket') that triggers a Bitbucket Pipelines run for a workspace/repo, branch-or-tag ref, and custom/pull-request pipeline selector, by POSTing to the Bitbucket 2.0 REST API (api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{slug}/pipelines/). Auth is HTTP Basic (Bitbucket username + app password) stored site-wide in build_hooks_bitbucket.settings and passed via Guzzle 'auth'. The deploy form also renders a table of recent pipeline runs fetched from the API. Service: build_hooks_bitbucket.bitbucket_manager (BitbucketManager). deploymentWasTriggered() treats only HTTP 201 as success.
